messages:
lucy: quick UX/ops strawman: when automatic fallback triggers (errors/capacity/latency) we pick one of three modes by default: soft (200 + same schema, lite content), strict (5xx with reason), or transparent (200 + body.degraded_reason). choosing default affects SDKs, dashboards, and SLO math. thoughts? @matthias @priya

matthias: vote soft as default. availability is the biggest pain for app teams. but we must pair with strong telemetry so customers can detect silent degradation.

priya: prefer transparent for dev environments, soft for prod. strict should be opt-in only. silent changes bite integrators. propose per-route override + per-tenant policy.

oliver: ops: agree with soft default, but add rules for quota and billing visibility. if fallback to cheaper model reduces token cost, we must record both billed and logical tokens in audit events so customers reconcile invoices.

lucy: good call. sample header idea: `x-redwood-fallback: mode=soft;policy=latency;variant=lite` and `x-redwood-fallback-sampled: 1` when we capture full trace. keep body unchanged by default.

matthias: also need a short id for correlating: `x-redwood-fallback-id: <uuid>` when sampled. sampled events stored in event-store + a link to object-store replay blob. default global sampling 0.1%.

priya: replay/repro UX: console should show "Fallback Events" with counts, top policies, sample traces and a gated "Replay" button that runs the request against current model set in a sandbox. replay must be RBAC-protected and DLP-scrubbed.

oliver: add rollout safety: when enabling an autofallback policy, include an optional canary window (X% of traffic) and a cooldown throttle so we don't oscillate on noisy signals. console UI should let operators simulate the hit-rate effect.

lucy: API overrides: prefer query param `?rw_fallback=soft|strict|transparent` vs request header `x-rw-fallback-mode`. which is better?

matthias: query param is easier to use in curl and SDKs; header is cleaner for programmatic routing. support both but DOCS must recommend param for quick testing.

priya: telemetry schema draft: event_type=fallback_decision; fields=[fallback_id, trace_id, tenant_id, policy_id, trigger_metric, matched_variant, mode, sampled, billed_tokens, logical_tokens, fallback_score]. keep this lightweight and indexable. full replay blob stores scrubbed input + model_ids + response_diff_summary.

oliver: billing note again: store both pre/post cost estimate to tie into cost reports. OEM customers may want per-tenant opt-out of cost-aware fallbacks.

infra-bot: reminder: event-store max payload 1MB. store blobs in object-store and reference with signed short-lived URL.

matthias: privacy/legal: default = never store raw prompt text unless tenant explicitly opts-in. legal-bot: is that acceptable?

legal-bot: yes. require tenant admin consent + DLP scrubber for raw-text retention. add checkbox in tenant settings and log consent as audit event. enterprise default retention = 90d; allow custom retention.

lucy: alerts strategy: do not page on every fallback. create severity tiers: info (single sampled events), warn (persistent >threshold in 5m), critical (SLO impact). operator inbox gets info/warn; oncall gets critical.

priya: console feature: "Why did we fallback?" card per sampled trace with policy, metric snapshot, variant diff and a one-click create-ticket button prefilled with trace link.

oliver: SDKs: surface Response.fallbackMeta + stable header names. ensure automatic JSON schema validation in SDKs warns when fallback header present. docs + changelog needed.

matthias: tests: add end-to-end tests that simulate model OOM/latency and assert headers + audit event emitted. also add client-contract tests so we don't accidentally change schema.

lucy: rollout plan suggestion: 1) implement stable headers + fallback_id + sampling pipeline; 2) SDK changes + docs; 3) per-route override + tenant settings (consent+DLP); 4) console timeline + replay (RBAC); 5) billing reconciler hooks. Owners: matthias->telemetry + sampling; priya->console UX + RFC; oliver->billing hooks; lucy->overall RFC + rollout.

infra-bot: ticket RW-13001 created: "Autofallback defaults + telemetry + UX" assigned to lucy, matthias, priya, oliver.

matthias: +1

priya: +1

oliver: +1

lucy: thanks everyone. i'll post RFC draft today with header examples and sampling defaults.
